declaration.description: SYNTHETIC FIXTURE CONF-08: recorded wafer-level metrology tool identical to the treatment: all 'low' wafers on M1, all 'high' wafers on M2

findings.message: Comparison 'high_vs_low' is not estimable once 'tool' is included: high - low cannot be separated from 'tool' differences (design-matrix rank; table [[6, 0], [0, 6]]). The data contain no temp comparison made within a level of 'tool'. More measurements below the 'run' level cannot restore that missing independent information. A crossed, randomized assignment of temp levels to tool levels is needed.

explanation.text: Every unit given one treatment level also shares a recorded nuisance level, such as a chamber, with no unit of the other treatment level; for example, all runs of one recipe were in one chamber and all runs of the other recipe in another. A treatment difference and a chamber difference would then produce exactly the same data, so no analysis can separate them. (For a numbered factor such as run order, the same happens when the treatment lines up exactly with a straight-line trend in it.) Measuring more wafers or sites does not help, because it adds no comparison of the treatments within a chamber. The design has to change so that every treatment level runs at every level of that factor, as in the reassignment suggestion when one is given.

allocation.reason: the comparison is not estimable (complete confounding), so no allocation of it exists; the reassignment suggestion gives the precision of a design that removes the confounding (D-078, D-080).

suggestions.reason: the factor is recorded below the experimental unit ('wafer'). The remedy is to balance it inside every run, which the blocked T2 of D-063 does not model, so v1 states the remedy and does not construct a plan (D-080).

planning.reason: the refusal reasons are within the planning pathway (D-081)
